      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "rebuilding the coinbase reward strictly with the block subsidy drops transaction fees when a template contains mempool transactions",
      "quote": "This is an assignment rather than an adjustment, so the template's fees go with it.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author asserted template is coinbase-only and disabled mempool in MinerTestingSetup::Block()",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4100107357"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4100107357",
      "status_by_quote": "Sure, added `.use_mempool = false` to `MinerTestingSetup::Block()` and asserted the shared helper receives a coinbase-only block."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3961009618",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add test coverage for target recalculation and coinbase adjustments in arbitrary parent rebuilding",
      "quote": "Removing the target, subsidy or padding line here leaves `blockfilter_index_tests` and `baseindex_tests` green, so nothing on that side covers what the branch changes.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added tests covering target recalculation and coinbase adjustments across halving",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4100145138"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4100145138",
      "status_by_quote": "Thanks! I added similar tests, with the coinbase cases combined into one fork test."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4549455873",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "document that the target recalculation test relies on regtest's 20-minute difficulty reset rule and a synthetic nBits",
      "quote": "In other words: please document this.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author documented the reliance on regtest difficulty rules and reviewer subsequently gave full ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4551433531"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6826835383",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4549508133",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "document the reason for restricting fork block reconstruction to coinbase-only templates",
      "quote": "let's document the reason for this restriction, so anyone who needs to relax it will know what to pay attention to.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author added comment explaining the restriction and reviewer subsequently gave full ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4551437206"

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6826835383",

      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "add a doc comment to MinerTestingSetup::Block describing its behavior and expectations",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author added documentation and reviewer subsequently gave full ACK",
